n = int(input())
p = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] /= 100.0

no = [0] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        if not ((j >> i) & 1):
            no[i] |= (1 << j)

m = {1: 1.0}
for i in range(n):
    M = {}
    for t, t_prob in m.items():
        for j in range(1 << n):
            prob = 1.0
            res = 0
            for k in range(n):
                if (j & (1 << k)):
                    prob *= p[i][k]
                    res |= ((t & no[k]) << (1 << k))
                else:
                    prob *= (1 - p[i][k])
            M[res] = M.get(res, 0) + t_prob * prob
    m = M

print(f"{m.get((1 << n) - 1, 0):.9f}")
